summary: @wbnr/design preinstall exfiltrates installer identity to attacker-controlled OAST endpoint
details: @wbnr/design@99.0.0 ships a preinstall.js lifecycle script that, on `npm install`, reads the installer's USER/USERNAME environment variable and os.hostname() and transmits them to the hardcoded subdomain 4otph6fase1x2won0hrfzul2wt2qqge5.oastify.com via both a DNS lookup and an HTTPS GET to https://4otph6fase1x2won0hrfzul2wt2qqge5.oastify.com/depconf/<pkg>/<host>/<hostname>. The package is published under the @wbnr scope at version 99.0.0 — the canonical dependency-confusion pattern designed to override an internal package of the same name in a target build environment. The package's own description labels it as a bug-bounty dependency-confusion PoC with 'harmless DNS callback only', but the behavior is unsolicited exfiltration of installer identifiers to an author-controlled out-of-band callback host, fired automatically at install time without installer consent.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
